cim: Tesla posts its Cybercab Autonomy Subscription Agreement, requiring personal buyers to pay a mandatory $299/month on top of the vehicle's $29,990 purchase price (Fred Lambert/Electrek)

prioritas.cim_hu: Kötelező havi 300 dolláros előfizetéssel érkezik a Tesla Cybercab
